response.overview: A documentary showcasing California's state parks, featuring forests, streams, waterfalls, mountains, marshes, and wildlife in Redwood, Humboldt, Calaveras, Tamalpais, Prairie Creek, Big Sur, and Cuyamaca Ranch State Parks. Civilian Conservation Corps (CCC) workers carry out conservation and development projects, including clearing undergrowth, processing lumber, building roads, trails, bridges, culverts, and structures, and removing dead trees and pests. The film also depicts the workers' daily activities and leisure time in the parks, along with views of wildlife refuges and waterfowl.
response.title: Land Of The Giants
